shots.visual: Extreme close-up of eyes flashing with red digital data streams. Dark, dramatic lighting.

lines.speaker: su_man
lines.text: 林曉，妳以為只有妳有外掛？

shots.visual: A red translucent system panel floats before her. She smirks at the confused opponent.
Startled expression, looking at the glitching air in front of the enemy.

lines.speaker: lin_xia
lines.text: 什麼？這劇本徹底亂套了。

shots.visual: Waving a hand, red energy ripples outward, causing the surrounding furniture to flicker.

lines.speaker: su_man
lines.text: 消失吧，妳這個礙眼的配角！

shots.visual: The office walls begin to dissolve into digital pixels. Chaos fills the room.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 警告：世界數據正在崩壞中。

shots.visual: Looking down at his own hands, which are becoming transparent and flickering.
Reaching out to grab his fading arm, but her hand passes right through him.
Appearing as a blue holographic boy, facial expressions showing rare urgency.

lines.speaker: system_boy
lines.text: 宿主，快找出她的代碼漏洞！

shots.visual: Laughing hysterically while the red screen behind her glows brighter.

lines.speaker: su_man
lines.text: 沒用的，我才是劇本的主角！

shots.visual: Frantically swiping through a blue floating menu, eyes searching for a fix.

lines.speaker: lin_xia
lines.text: 小白，強行切斷她的權限！

shots.visual: A red warning 'ERROR' sign flashes over his holographic body.

lines.speaker: system_boy
lines.text: 權限不足，男主即將被刪除！

shots.visual: Body is now 70% transparent, looking at her with deep affection and sorrow.

lines.speaker: gu_ting
lines.text: 如果我消失，妳也要活下去。

shots.visual: Tears in eyes, but expression turns from grief to fierce determination.

lines.speaker: lin_xia
lines.text: 不！我絕不接受這種垃圾結局！

shots.visual: He completely vanishes into white light. The screen turns red with a deletion countdown.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 顧霆，正在從世界中抹除……
